nights.title: Skye Newman
nights.name: Skye Newman
nights.extract: Skye Newman is an English singer-songwriter from south-east London.

nights.title: The Rifles
nights.name: The Rifles
nights.extract: The Rifles are an English indie rock band from Chingford, London.

nights.title: Kid Kapichi
nights.name: Kid Kapichi
nights.extract: Kid Kapichi are an English punk rock band formed in Hastings in 2013. The band consists of vocalist and guitarist Jack Wilson and bassist Eddie Lewis.
